mission.name: Basic Training
mission.description: Learn the controls: move into cover, aim and fire, throw a grenade, set overwatch, extract. The targets don't shoot back.

unit.name: Dummy

tile.label: MOVE HERE

zone.label: EVAC
zone.script: if flag("trained") == 1 { message("Training complete. Welcome to the squad!"); win(); }

mission.script: message("Welcome to Basic Training. Right-drag rotates, the wheel zooms, H shows every control."); objective("Click the yellow MOVE HERE tile to move a soldier into cover");
if round == 6 && flag("trained") == 0 { message("Take your time - the dummies aren't going anywhere."); }
